decisions.label: Silhouette
decisions.note: Where scenery still hides her, her shape drawn flat in her glow colour through it, at this strength: 0.55 as built, 0 none (she's simply hidden), 1 a solid glow-coloured cut-out. Live.

decisions.label: See-through
decisions.note: How clear the soft circle round her is at its middle, where tall things in front of her fade: 0 as built (fully see-through there), 1 not at all (solid: no circle, the silhouette alone shows her). Live.

decisions.label: Soft edge
decisions.note: Where the circle eases back to solid, as a share of its radius past her body: 3 as built; lower, a smaller, harder-edged hole; higher, a wider, softer one. Live.

decisions.label: Fade things taller than (m)
decisions.note: Only things taller than this (metres) standing in front of her fade round her: 2.5 as built, so bushes and props stay solid and trees, rocks and ruins fade; 0, everything in front of her fades. Live.

decisions.label: Glow colour (hue)
decisions.note: Her own glow's colour round the colour wheel (light.spooky.glowHue, the spooky mood's; render/lighting.ts uGlowRgb): 0.08 as built, a warm amber-orange; 0 red, 0.17 yellow, 0.33 green, 0.5 cyan, 0.67 blue, 0.83 magenta. Her pool on the ground, its light on what's near her and her silhouette all take it; the swatch is the colour. Live.

decisions.label: Glow colour (saturation)
decisions.note: How coloured her glow is (light.spooky.glowSat): 0.55 as built; 0 white light, 1 the hue at its deepest. Live.

decisions.label: Glow strength
decisions.note: Her own glow at its brightest (glowPower): 0.95 as built; 0 no glow (her silhouette keeps its colour); over 1 the bright middle of her pool spreads wider, as the light is capped at full. Live.
